observations.body: The hymn-like passage names creation, headship, beginning, fullness, reconciliation, peace through cross-blood, former alienation, present reconciliation, and continued hope.

payload.posture: Read Colossians 1:15–23 as its own the cross in letters and later memory crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
